about: Pass 5.3 Lane S manual field coverage: swarm topology and workload (docker_service, docker_stack, docker_secret, docker_config, docker_node, docker_swarm_init, docker_swarm_node). Docker daemon source citations are paths in the Go module cache under github.com/docker/docker@v28.5.2+incompatible.

engine:ServiceCreate/TaskTemplate/Contai.skip: The daemon drops it when it converts a service spec to swarmkit: containerToGRPC copies only Propagation and NonRecursive of BindOptions (moby docker-v29.9.3 daemon/cluster/convert/container.go:397-411, the harness engine), so a service cannot use it; TestAccServiceP53_daemonDropsMountFields pins this, implement it when that test fails. Re-verified on Engine 29.9.3 (API 1.56): TestAccServiceP53_daemonDropsMountFields passes.

The daemon never converts Mount.Consistency for services (moby docker-v29.9.3 daemon/cluster/convert/container.go:383-436, has no Consistency), and no Linux daemon code acts on it: it only accepts the mode names (swagger.yaml:427-428 Mount.Consistency; moby docker-v29.9.3 daemon/volume/mounts/linux_parser.go:136); TestAccServiceP53_daemonDropsMountFields pins it. Re-verified on Engine 29.9.3 (API 1.56): TestAccServiceP53_daemonDropsMountFields passes.

Image mounts exist for containers only (CHANGELOG.md:222, v1.48: POST /containers/create supports Mount of type image); the service conversion maps Mount.Type through swarmkit's Mount_MountType enum and rejects other types (moby docker-v29.9.3 daemon/cluster/convert/container.go:391-395), and swarmkit v2.1.3 vendored by docker v29.9.3 has no image type (vendor/github.com/moby/swarmkit/v2/api/types.pb.go:240-246); TestAccServiceP53_daemonDropsMountFields pins it.
